svg.aria-label: Feasibility of every (workers, shards) pair against the 15-minute deadline. 54 workers and 9 shards is the cheapest pair that survives the full stress envelope.
svg.text: Where the 15-minute deadline can actually be met
Each cell is one candidate deployment. The deadline alone admits far more shapes than the stress envelope does.
4,981 of the shapes searched meet the deadline; only 448 meet the whole envelope. The cost band is flat to a few percent, so the deadline
alone leaves a dozen indistinguishable choices — the two STRUCTURAL conditions are what actually decide it. The dark band runs along W = 6S,
where every instance is saturated and none contended.
